content_of_post_to_comment: Fiction is actually so insane because what do you mean you can READ SOMEONE’S IMAGINATION. SOMEONE’S IMAGINATION GETS TRANSMUTED INTO YOUR IMAGINATION. THAT’S INSANE THAT WE CAN DO THAT.
comment: The wild part is that fiction isn't just transferring images from one mind to another; it's creating a shared space where two consciousnesses can meet across time. I wonder if that makes every reader a kind of co-author.
